commitResults.messageTitle: Added commands feature with corrct output
added subclasses for new task types
added task conter changes structured statments
added logic in sub classes for error
Add SE-EDU coding and Git conventions to AGENTS.md
commitResults.messageBody:
Document the SE-EDU Java coding standard and Git conventions as
project-specific requirements, and normalize list markers to
hyphens for consistency. This ensures all future edits and
commits in the repository follow a single, explicit standard
rather than relying on implicit conventions.

Group Jeff, Task, Todo, Deadline, and Event under a single
lowercase jeff package, per the SE-EDU Java coding standard
(every class belongs in a meaningful package). This also makes
it possible to add a Storage class in the same package that can
reference Task and its subclasses, needed for the upcoming
save/load feature.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add toSaveFormat to Task and its subclasses
commitResults.messageBody:
Add a toSaveFormat() method, mirroring the existing toString()
pattern, so each task can encode itself as a single pipe-delimited
line (type | done-flag | description | extra fields). This is the
on-disk representation the upcoming Storage class will read and
write.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add Storage class for reading and writing task data
commitResults.messageBody:
Introduce Storage, which loads a List<Task> from a save file and
writes one back, using the pipe-delimited toSaveFormat() encoding.
Missing save files and corrupted lines are handled gracefully
(empty list / skipped line) rather than crashing the chatbot.
Not yet wired into Jeff.

commitResults.messageTitle: Load and save tasks automatically in Jeff
commitResults.messageBody:
Load history from ./data/jeff.txt on startup, and save it back
via Storage after every mutation (add, mark, unmark, delete), so
the task list survives across runs without any explicit save
command. Ignore the generated data/ folder since it holds runtime
state, not source.

Bring in automatic save/load of tasks to and from
./data/jeff.txt: package reorganization under jeff, the
toSaveFormat() encoding on Task and its subclasses, the Storage
class, and its wiring into Jeff so the task list persists across
runs without any explicit save command.

commitResults.messageTitle: Store Deadline's by date as a LocalDate
commitResults.messageBody:
Parse the /by argument with LocalDate.parse (yyyy-mm-dd), instead
of keeping it as a plain String, so date comparisons and range
queries are possible later. Print it back as "MMM dd yyyy" (e.g.
Oct 15 2019), and reject blank or wrongly formatted input with a
clear error message rather than accepting anything.

commitResults.messageTitle: Store Event's from/to dates as LocalDate
commitResults.messageBody:
Same treatment as Deadline: parse /from and /to with LocalDate.parse
(yyyy-mm-dd) instead of storing them as plain Strings, print them
back as "MMM dd yyyy", and reject blank or wrongly formatted input
with a message naming which argument failed.

Bring in date/time understanding for deadlines and events: parse
/by, /from, and /to arguments as java.time.LocalDate (yyyy-mm-dd
input), print them as "MMM dd yyyy", and store them in ISO format
on disk so saved dates round-trip correctly.

commitResults.messageTitle: Extract TaskList to own the task collection
commitResults.messageBody:
Move the task-storing List<Task> and its add/remove/get/size
operations out of Jeff and into a new TaskList class. Jeff now
delegates to a TaskList instance instead of manipulating a static
list field directly; behavior is unchanged.

commitResults.messageTitle: Extract Ui to own user interaction
commitResults.messageBody:
Move all printing (banner, divider, task confirmations, errors)
and the input Scanner out of Jeff and into a new Ui class. Jeff
now delegates to a Ui instance instead of calling System.out and
Scanner directly; behavior and message wording are unchanged.

commitResults.messageTitle: Extract Parser to make sense of user input
commitResults.messageBody:
Move the Command enum, command-word/argument splitting, the
deadline/event "/label" splitting, and task-number parsing out of
Jeff and into a new Parser class. Jeff now delegates to Parser
instead of parsing raw input itself; behavior is unchanged.

Jeff is now a thin orchestrator over Ui, Storage, Parser, and
TaskList, completing the minimal OOP extraction.

Move Ui to a new jeff.ui sub-package, replacing the flat jeff
package, as part of organizing the codebase into suitable Java
packages. Update Ui's own reference to Task, and Jeff (which
creates and uses a Ui instance), with the new explicit imports.

Move Storage to a new jeff.storage sub-package, replacing the
flat jeff package, as part of organizing the codebase into
suitable Java packages. Update Storage's own references to Task,
Todo, Deadline, and Event, and Jeff (which creates and uses a
Storage instance), with the new explicit imports.

commitResults.messageTitle: Move task classes into jeff.task package
commitResults.messageBody:
Group Task, Todo, Deadline, Event, and TaskList under a new
jeff.task sub-package, replacing the flat jeff package, as part
of organizing the codebase into suitable Java packages. Update
Jeff, Storage, and Ui (which reference these classes) with the
new explicit imports.

Move Parser to a new jeff.parser sub-package, replacing the flat
jeff package, as part of organizing the codebase into suitable
Java packages. Update Jeff (which calls Parser's methods and
switches on its nested Command enum) with the new explicit
import.
Move Task, Todo, Deadline, Event, and TaskList into jeff.task.

Move Ui into jeff.ui.

commitResults.messageTitle: Fix cross-package Javadoc links after package split
commitResults.messageBody:
Task and TaskList had {@link Storage}/{@link Ui} references left
over from when everything lived in one flat jeff package. Now
that Storage and Ui live in jeff.storage and jeff.ui, qualify
those links with their full package name so they still resolve.

Bring the OOP extraction and package reorganization work onto
master as a single branch, rather than the separate
branch-A-MoreOOP/branch-A-Packages(-*) branches they were
originally done on:

- Extract Ui, Storage, Parser, and TaskList out of Jeff, so it
  becomes a thin orchestrator (the A-MoreOOP increment).
- Organize all classes into suitable sub-packages (jeff.task,
  jeff.ui, jeff.storage, jeff.parser) instead of one flat jeff
  package (the A-Packages increment).

Bring in Gradle build support (build.gradle, gradle wrapper)
from the course's add-gradle-support branch, so the project can
be built and run via Gradle instead of raw javac/java commands.

commitResults.messageTitle: Point Gradle build at jeff.Jeff instead of the template class
commitResults.messageBody:
The merged add-gradle-support branch's build.gradle still named
the course template's seedu.duke.Duke as the application main
class and duke.jar as the shadow jar output. Update both to
match this project's actual entry point (jeff.Jeff) and name
(jeff.jar), so `gradlew run`/`gradlew shadowJar` work correctly.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add JUnit tests for Task and Todo
commitResults.messageBody:
Cover Task's description validation, done/not-done status
transitions, and toString/toSaveFormat output, plus Todo's
overrides of the same. First step of adding JUnit test coverage
across the codebase (A-JUnit).

commitResults.messageTitle: Add JUnit tests for Deadline and Event
commitResults.messageBody:
Cover the date-parsing logic in both classes: blank fields,
malformed dates, whitespace trimming, and the MMM dd yyyy /
ISO-8601 formatting in toString and toSaveFormat. This is the
most bug-prone part of these classes, so it gets the most cases.

Cover the empty/pre-populated constructors (including that the
pre-populated one copies its input rather than aliasing it),
add, remove, and getTasks.

Cover parseCommandType (every recognized word, unknown/empty
input, case sensitivity), getArguments, splitDeadlineArgs and
splitEventArgs (valid input and missing segments), and
parseTaskIndex (valid, non-numeric, and out-of-range input).

Cover loading from a missing file (empty list, no crash), a full
save/load round trip via a temp file, auto-creating a missing
parent directory on save, and skipping corrupted lines (unknown
type letter, too few fields) on load without losing the rest.

Cover message indentation, the divider, welcome/bye/error text,
task-list/added/removed/marked/unmarked formatting (via
System.out redirection), and readCommand for both an available
line and end-of-input (via System.in redirection).

This completes JUnit coverage of every non-trivial public method
across Task, Todo, Deadline, Event, TaskList, Parser, Storage,
and Ui. Jeff's main() itself is left untested, since it's a thin
stdin/stdout-driven loop rather than a unit of logic.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add missing Javadoc to Task, Todo, Deadline, and Event
commitResults.messageBody:
Add a class-level header to Task, and method-level Javadoc to
every constructor and public method across all four classes
(including the toString/toSaveFormat overrides), so each
documents its parameters, return value, and thrown exceptions
where applicable. Deadline, Event, TaskList, Parser, Storage, and
Ui already had most of their public API documented from earlier
increments; this fills the remaining gaps.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add missing Javadoc to Storage and Jeff
commitResults.messageBody:
Document Storage's constructor, plus Jeff's class header and
main() method (its only previously-undocumented public member).
Combined with the earlier Task/Todo/Deadline/Event commit, every
non-private class and method in the codebase now has a Javadoc
header, and non-trivial private methods already did from earlier
increments.

commitResults.messageTitle: Wrap Ui.showTaskRemoved to fit the 120-char line limit
commitResults.messageBody:
showTaskRemoved's message-building line was 121 characters, one
over the SE-EDU coding standard's line-length limit. Wrap it the
same way showTaskList already wraps its own multi-part message.

Add a description accessor to Task, and a find(keyword) method
to TaskList that returns the tasks whose description contains
the given keyword, in list order. This is the data-layer piece
of the Level-9 "find" feature; command wiring follows separately.

Add "find" to the recognized Command words. No new argument-
splitting helper is needed: getArguments already extracts the
keyword the same way it extracts a todo's description.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add Ui.showMatchingTasks for the find command
commitResults.messageBody:
Extract the numbered-list printing shared by showTaskList and the
new showMatchingTasks into a private showNumberedTasks helper, so
"find" results print the same way "list" results do, just under
a different header.

commitResults.messageTitle: Wire the find command into Jeff
commitResults.messageBody:
Add the FIND case: rejects a blank keyword with an error, same as
other commands with required arguments, otherwise looks up
matching tasks via TaskList.find and shows them via
Ui.showMatchingTasks. Completes the Level-9 "find" feature.

Add missing Javadoc across Task, Todo, Deadline, Event, Storage,
and Jeff, completing header-comment coverage of every non-private
class/method and non-trivial private method (A-JavaDoc).

Fix the one SE-EDU coding-standard violation found on audit: a
121-character line in Ui.showTaskRemoved, wrapped to fit the
120-char limit (A-CodingStandard).

Add the "find KEYWORD" command: Task.getDescription,
TaskList.find, Parser's FIND command, Ui.showMatchingTasks, and
Jeff wiring (Level-9).
